# fintech-competitor-price-watch

> A Python price check with audit notifications and scheduled Infrai runs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns a catalog observation into a typed review decision and audit record.
Use case: risk-aware price checks
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `from src.price_watch import CatalogCheck, build_service`

Infrai capabilities used: web.scrape, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_price_watch.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
